item.title: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration — Procurement: Executive Order 85 Online eLearning Program
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The Mayor s Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence (ENDGBV) is required under Executive Order 85 (2021) to develop a 50 60-minute eLearning module on domestic and gender-based violence (DV/GBV) for all NYC employees. The training will be delivered in two parts and cover: *An introduction to DV/GBV *The City s workplace policy *Survivor-centered and trauma-informed responses for employees impacted by DV/GBV.
